project_info.theme: Urban streetwear editorial collage with analog ghosting and fictional music UI
project_info.creative_direction: 9:16 multi-panel fashion poster blending reflective glass, cobblestone street snapshots, and restrained digital overlays
project_info.color_palette: warm ambers, washed neutrals, soft gray, muted brown, polished leather, and stone pavement

main_subject.detail: adult streetwear model with relaxed confident expression, brown cap, and oversized amber-tinted rectangular sunglasses
main_subject.wardrobe: brown plaid blazer, white button-up shirt, yellow tie, loose dark trousers, and wired earphones
main_subject.poses: phone held before face in reflective window, hands in pockets on cobblestones, and overhead selfie holding a drink

composition_elements.framing: 9:16 editorial multi-panel collage with reflective window frame upper left, downward ultra-wide street portrait upper right, and overhead selfie lower right
composition_elements.effects: layered ghosting, architectural overlays, curvature distortion, radiating cobblestones, faint digital grid, and minimal square facial-bounding graphic
composition_elements.ui_elements: fictional translucent music-player card with invented track title and artist, abstract artwork, timeline, and playback controls; no Apple, Spotify, real artist, or platform branding
composition_elements.constraints: no stickers, extra subjects, wardrobe changes, incorrect fictional UI icons, neon color shifts, or futuristic sci-fi elements

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft overcast daylight at approximately 5600K with warm shop-window bounce
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: quiet street realism, reflective glass, muted color, natural skin, and subtle analog grain

technical_specs.render_style: full-frame camera with 28mm and 50mm lenses across panels, photoreal editorial collage
technical_specs.finish: realistic wool plaid, polished leather, stone pavement, controlled ghosting, and restrained digital texture

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a 9:16 urban streetwear editorial collage with a retro analog-digital fusion aesthetic. Feature the same clearly adult woman in every panel wearing a brown plaid blazer, white button-up shirt, yellow tie, loose dark trousers, brown cap, oversized amber-tinted rectangular sunglasses, and wired earphones. In the upper-left panel, show a reflective window shot with the phone held before her face, layered ghosting, architectural overlays, and curvature distortion. In the upper-right panel, create a close-range downward-angled ultra-wide portrait on a cobblestone street with hands in pockets and a confident closed-lip expression. In the lower-right panel, show an intimate overhead selfie holding a drink with soft overcast light and a faint digital-grid facial bounding graphic. Add a translucent fictional music-player card with invented track title, artist, abstract artwork, timeline, and generic playback controls; do not use Apple, Spotify, real artist, platform, or logo branding. Use warm ambers, washed neutrals, soft grays, muted browns, reflective glass, wool plaid, polished leather, stone pavement, restrained ghosting, and no futuristic sci-fi elements.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexual pose, fetish framing, ambiguous age, exaggerated pout, real music platform, real artist, real song title, real logo, watermark, stickers, extra subjects, wardrobe changes, neon color shifts, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed, incorrect UI icons
